profile.headline: IT Manager at Trans-Consolidated Distributors, Inc.
profile.summary:
Thank you very much for visiting my profile, I am absolutely looking forward to a long and happy networking relationship with you.

About Me:
Hands-on Information Technology specialist and innovative Webmaster with vast experience leveraging search engine optimization, internet marketing, and web trafficking methodologies to deliver highly effective and creative solutions to business and technology challenges. A team leader with experience in building and motivating professional, capable and responsive organizations. I utilize highly attuned analytical skills to develop IT and business strategies. I engage cutting-edge technologies to increase productivity. I consistently drive a high standard of service to develop and manage strong client relationships and also highly organized with a strong capacity to prioritize workload, delegate deliverables and steer project completion within the established deadline.

My working experience as an IT specialist has spanned well over 17 years during this period I have had the opportunity to work with vast arrays of technologies, extensively on IT infrastructures and enterprise systems, and also with a team of highly skilled experts in the field of Information Technology.
Specialties: Market Research, Digital Advertising,	Search Engine Optimization, Search Engine Marketing, Internet Marketing,   Software Analysis, Database Management, Social Media Marketing, Information Security, Project Management, SERPs, Google Adwords & Analytics, Technical Troubleshooting, Scripting Languages,Programming Languages, Web Design & Development, Keyword Research, Web Hosting, End-User Support

I love meeting new people and learning new things, so please feel free to say hello and share a story with me

positions.title: Information Technology System Manager
positions.description: Skills: E-commerce Optimization · Analytical Skills · Facebook Ads · Amazon Seller Central · MailChimp · Amazon Marketing Services (AMS) · Search Engine Optimization (SEO) · Google Ads · AVG · Digital Marketing · Debian · Samba · WordPress · QuickBooks · Networking · HubSpot

positions.title: Webmaster
positions.description:
•	Researched market trends to keep up with best practices in SEO, social media promotion, search analytics, and web hosting
•	Designed and maintained all company websites (e.g., main site, e-commerce site, ticket support system, rebate system)
•	Oversee the setup, configure and maintain company's web hosting server and the whole company email servers and accounts
•	Improved the company's online presence by managing the company's social media accounts, press releases, and newsletter campaigns (e.g., Facebook, Twitter, Google+, Pinterest, Youtube, Vimeo)
•	Increased web traffic and boosted sales by 2x by controlling the company’s Google Adwords Campaigns (i.e., Text, Video, Images), as well as the eBay account, Amazon Seller Central Account, Amazon Vendor Central and Amazon Marketing services account campaign
•	Consistently train employees to develop tech skills to use all the systems (e.g. Rebate Website, Ticket Support)
•	Supervise the setup and maintenance of company’s VOIP dial plan

positions.title: Search Engine Optimization Analyst
positions.description:
•	Increased company and clients' leads generation and web traffic through strategic website analysis and well conducted keywords research
•	Thoroughly optimized existing websites to conform to standard web policy and for search optimization purpose
•	Improved search engine optimization by applying Google related services for SEO/SEM functions; (Google Analytics, Google Webmaster Tools, Google Adwords, Bing Webmaster Tools, and Google Merchants for E-commerce Websites) 
•	Created Social Media Pages on Facebook, Twitter and Foursquare for client website
•	Verified and claimed client website to different directories like Manta, Hotfrog, etc

positions.title: Part Time Webmaster/Technical Support Specialist
positions.locationName: West Palm Beach, Florida, United States
positions.description:
•	Successfully collaborated in the set-up, maintenance and administration of the whole company website and server 
•	Efficiently maintained the company’s website for any new updates, sustained and enhanced the client websites
•	Successfully managed web development projects from initiation through completion and all other web development work that may arise
•	Handled the designing and building of websites and applied Google related services (Google Analytics, Google Webmaster Tools, Google Adwords, Bing Webmaster Tools, and Google Merchants for E-commerce Website) for SEO/SEM functions
•	Analyzed, designed, code tested and maintained information system applications programs
•	Resolve application systems problem by providing technical support in coordination with the network, desktop support and help desk managers
•	Communicates with the customer to resolve incidents
•	Ensured appropriate written documentation is created and maintained for each information system application develops

company.name: Trial Exhibits, Inc., Performance Marine, Inc., Gilbert Company

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Designed and created optimized landing pages in HTML5 and CSS to support company's marketing and promotional needs which includes SalesForce integration and cross-browser compatibility
•	Thoroughly optimized sections of the website to ensure a more attractive and user friendly experience
•	Designed and managed the development of eCommerce systems for the owner
•	Provided technical support to resolve application system problem in coordination with the network and desktop support
•	Ensured appropriate written documentation is created and maintained for each information system applications develop
•	Prioritized and fixed site-related design problems and took the initiative to implement new features based on feedback from users

positions.title: Technical Support Specialist
positions.locationName: Metro Manila, National Capital Region, Philippines
positions.description:
•	Facilitated the creation of product support plans to improve end user experience
•	Enhanced the Enterworks’ Project Team support process by proffering strategic analysis and estimating and resolving problems or incidents
•	Ensured that all code changes are made following appropriate software configuration management procedures
•	Conducted proper unit testing and regression testing before shipping the patch to the customer
•	Updated the Support Lead of the status of all support activities assigned
•	Enhanced the operations of the Support Lead in ensuring timely resolution of all problems reported
•	Obtained feedback or incident status by communicating with the customer 
•	Performed troubleshooting by utilizing source code to make fixes to reported SPRs (System Problem Reports)

positions.title: Computer Programmer
positions.locationName: Metro Manila, National Capital Region, Philippines
positions.description:
•	Enhanced the set-up, maintenance and administration of DOST-ICT Infrastructure
•	Implemented new web oriented DBA request system replacing old e-mail oriented request system which reduced manpower and faster processing
•	Analyzed, Designed, code test and maintained information system applications programs
•	Provided technical support to resolve application systems problem in coordination with the network, desktop support and help desk managers
•	Facilitated the development and refinement of policies and procedures relating to security, data integrity and documentation of servers system
•	Provided user training in the use of network services
•	Analyzed data running numerous queries on the daily basis, pulling data from different databases, and producing reports
•	Ensured appropriate written documentation is created and maintained for each information system application develop
